items.content: SampleSampleZelleSample is simplest and costs you nothing extra. Send to Sample908 906 1745Sample and put Sample<MS-2026-XXX>Sample in the memo so we can match it to your invoice.SampleSampleSampleCardSample, if that is easier. items._fee_rule: 2.99% + $0.49 is PayPal's real published US rate. It is NOT 4%. That wrong number was live on CBC's portal and in the invoice template until 2026-08-25.
